name: Project Performance & Analytics
description: Rocketlane project delivery analytics: project progress, overdue and at-risk tasks, project cost, time to value, task breakdown by project, the onboarding runway and the overdue task queue.

tiles.name: Monthly Project Progress Average

tiles.name: Top 15 Projects Task Breakdown
tiles.description: Task status summary by project name (active projects).
tiles.search: [Project Name] [Tasks] [Completed Tasks] [In-progress Tasks] [To-do Tasks] [Project Status] = 'active' sort by [Tasks] descending top 15

tiles.name: Top 10 Projects Risk Overview
tiles.description: Overdue and at-risk tasks comparison (active projects).
tiles.search: [Overdue Tasks] [Tasks At Risk] [Project Name] [Project Status] = 'active' sort by [Overdue Tasks] descending top 10

tiles.name: Overdue task queue: open tasks past due
